command: ! (test -e /usr/bin/vi || test -L /usr/bin/vi ) || ( stat -c 'user=%U group=%G mode=%A atime=%X mtime=%Y ctime=%Z size=%s uid=%u gid=%g %N' /usr/bin/vi 2> /dev/null || stat -f 'user=%Su group=%Sg mode=%Sp atime=%a mtime=%m ctime=%c size=%z uid=%u gid=%g %N%SY' /usr/bin/vi || ( ls -ld /usr/bin/vi && ls -ldn /usr/bin/vi ) )
